{{Top|leg}}
The '''Issori-Odenji government''' was the ruling body of the [[Trulalis system]], and the [[Issori]] and [[Odenji]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was a bi-cameral legislature, made up of two separate house&mdash;the [[Tribe of Issori]] and the [[Tribe of Odenji]]. The laws passed by the government affected the entire [[Star system/Legends|system]], and members of the respective houses were voted in for life by their own species.<ref name="AE">''[[Alien Encounters]]''</ref>
